title: vLLM Inference
description: vLLM only (namespace vllm): engine state, throughput, decode and prefill speed, latency, queue, KV cache and its GPUs. Parked (0 replicas) is a normal state when another engine has the cards.

options.content: **vLLM only.** Every query here is pinned to `namespace="vllm"`. Strata exports the same `vllm:` metric names from its own namespace and has its own board, so nothing here mixes engines. When the engine tile says **Parked**, vLLM is at 0 replicas on purpose and empty panels are expected: widen the time range to see earlier runs. Model, flags and staging: `my-apps/ai/vllm/README.md`. Engines side by side: **Local LLM Engines**.

panels.title: vLLM engine

targets.expr:
max(absent(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="vllm", deployment="vllm-server"})) * 4
  or (max(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="vllm", deployment="vllm-server"}) == 0) * 0 + 0
  or (max(up{namespace="vllm", job="vllm-service"}) == 0) * 0 + 1
  or (max(vllm:engine_sleep_state{namespace="vllm", sleep_state="awake"}) == 0) * 0 + 3
  or (max(up{namespace="vllm", job="vllm-service"}) == 1) * 0 + 2
  or vector(1)

panels.description: From Git replicas, the vLLM scrape target and its own state. Parked means 0 replicas on purpose (the other engine has the cards), not an outage.

panels.title: Generated tokens/s now
panels.description: Wall clock across all running requests: idle time counts, so it reads 0 between requests.

panels.title: KV cache used
panels.description: Share of vLLM's GPU KV block pool in use (1 = full); a full pool queues or preempts.

panels.title: Prefix cache hit (range)

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range])) / sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Prompt tokens served from the GPU prefix cache instead of recomputed.

panels.title: Per-stream decode speed (range)

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:request_generation_tokens_sum{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range])) / sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:request_decode_time_seconds_sum{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Generated tokens ÷ summed per-request decode time. Concurrent requests each count their own time, so this is the speed one stream sees, not the batch total.

panels.title: Per-stream speed, 1 ÷ mean inter-token latency (range)

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_count{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range])) / sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_sum{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Token-weighted across every stream in the range; long answers dominate. Not one request.

panels.title: Prefill speed (range)

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model", source="local_compute"}[$__range])) / sum by (model_name) (increase(vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds_sum{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Computed (not cached) prompt tokens ÷ summed per-request prefill time.

panels.title: Wall-clock generation throughput (range)
panels.description: All generated tokens ÷ the whole range, idle time included: a busy-ness number, not speed.

panels.title: Tokens per second (wall clock)
panels.description: Idle time counts as 0. Prompt tokens split into computed (prefill work) and prefix-cache hits.

panels.title: Per-stream decode speed

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:request_generation_tokens_sum{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:request_decode_time_seconds_sum{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_count{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_sum{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range

panels.description: Speed one stream sees while generating, averaged over every stream in the window.

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model", source="local_compute"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds_sum{namespace="vllm", model_name=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

defaults.noValue: No finished requests in this range
